# Flaim Fantasy

> Flaim connects your real ESPN, Yahoo, and Sleeper fantasy leagues to the AI assistants you already use, so the advice is about your team instead of generic fantasy takes.

## What Flaim Is

Flaim is a free service that gives supported AI assistants read-only access to your real fantasy sports data. It supplies your roster, matchups, standings, available players, league rules, recent moves, and history so answers are about your league instead of generic rankings.

Flaim Fantasy is available in ChatGPT and Claude. Perplexity can connect through its current remote-connector settings.

Single MCP endpoint: https://api.flaim.app/mcp

## Available League Data (9 read-only actions plus Refresh)

| Action | What it does |
|------|-------------|
| get_user_session | Lists all connected leagues across all platforms |
| refresh_leagues | Re-discovers connected leagues and updates Flaim's league records |
| get_ancient_history | Past seasons and historical leagues outside the current-season view |
| get_league_info | League settings, scoring format, and members |
| get_roster | Team roster with player stats and lineup slots |
| get_matchups | Weekly matchups and scores |
| get_standings | League standings and rankings |
| get_free_agents | Available players in your league, with the same core fields on every platform; ESPN/Yahoo include platform-wide ownership percentages, Sleeper returns identities |
| get_players | Player lookup with ownership context |
| get_transactions | Recent adds, drops, waivers, and trades |

## Supported Platforms and Sports

| Platform | Sports | Auth Method |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| ESPN | Football, Baseball, Basketball, Hockey | Chrome extension required for private ESPN leagues |
| Yahoo | Football, Baseball, Basketball, Hockey | Yahoo sign-in |
| Sleeper | Football, Basketball | Username only (public API) |

## How to Connect

1. Create a Flaim account at https://flaim.app
2. Connect your fantasy leagues at https://flaim.app/leagues:
   - ESPN: Install the Chrome extension to sync private ESPN leagues
   - Yahoo: Sign in with Yahoo from /leagues and wait for league discovery
   - Sleeper: Enter your exact username and wait for league discovery
3. Connect your AI app, authorize Flaim, and ask "What fantasy leagues do I have?" to confirm setup:
   - ChatGPT: Open Flaim Fantasy in ChatGPT
   - Claude: Find Flaim Fantasy in Claude's connector directory
   - Perplexity: Follow the remote-connector instructions on the AI Apps page

Optional manual connector paths use the same server URL after leagues are connected: https://api.flaim.app/mcp

After connecting, Your Leagues is where users can add leagues, sync seasons, and choose optional defaults.

## Example Prompts

- "Who should I start this week?"
- "Who's on the waiver wire?"
- "Show me the standings"
- "What trades happened this week?"
- "Who are the best available QBs?"
- "Compare my roster to my opponent's"
- "What fantasy leagues do I have?"
- "How has my team done over the last 3 weeks?"

## FAQs

### What does Flaim do?
Flaim connects your real fantasy leagues to the AI assistants you already use. It lets you ask about your actual roster, matchup, standings, recent moves, available players, waiver wire, and more.

### Is my data safe?
Flaim is read-only. It cannot trade, drop, or modify anything in your league. ESPN credentials are encrypted and stored securely. They are never shared with AI providers.

### Why does ESPN need a Chrome extension?
ESPN doesn't offer a public API for private fantasy league data. For private ESPN leagues, the Chrome extension syncs the session details Flaim needs for read-only access.

### How does Flaim connect to AI clients?
Flaim Fantasy is available directly in ChatGPT and Claude. Other AI apps that support remote MCP connectors can add the single server URL, and Flaim handles authentication and data retrieval after your leagues are linked in /leagues.

### What AI assistants work with Flaim?
Flaim Fantasy is available in ChatGPT and Claude. Perplexity can connect through its remote-connector settings where supported. See the AI Apps page for current availability and connection instructions.
